period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention (for Q1, cumulative equals the discrete first-quarter figure) established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 31 March 2016'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (1st_quarter_2016.pdf) is a native digital PDF, but pdftotext -layout's initial extraction dropped/misaligned several deep P&L rows (Contribution to NCC Bank Foundation, Profit before tax, Provision for tax, and Profit after tax all appeared blank or column-shifted for the current period). Figures below were instead confirmed via a 300dpi visual render of the same source page, which is fully internally consistent: Profit after provision 681,149,369 - Contribution to NCC Bank Foundation (nil this quarter) = Profit before tax 681,149,369; Provision for tax 340,257,246 (current tax 407,563,570 + deferred tax income 67,306,324); Profit after tax 340,892,123, matching the filing's own EPS of 0.39. Balance sheet was extracted cleanly and ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 130,175,576,372 + Total Shareholders' Equity 15,952,898,397 = Total Assets 146,128,474,769). Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2015' column (Total Assets BDT 146,369.95mn, Total Shareholders' Equity BDT 15,654.64mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2015_Q4.json exactly.

source.source_page_lines: Source PDF page 8 (Balance Sheet, 'As at 31 March 2016') and page 9 (Profit and Loss Account, 'For the first quarter ended on 31 March 2016'). pdftotext -layout lines 284-345 and 374-435 (with several P&L values re-verified via a 300dpi page render due to column-alignment extraction defects on that specific page).
